name: Fluffland
source:
All of sudden, you find yourself in a soft, fluffy world filled with beings called fluffs. Without a way to go home in your current situation, you will have to start a new life in this fantastical land, Fluffland.

Interact with the fluffs and follow their lives! Would you try to find a way to go back home or will you like to live in the Fluffland permanently?

Either way, you can explore this magical world, unlock new features and find out the secrets behind this fluffy world, Fluffland and its inhabitants.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fluffness/fluffland]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
你突然发现自己身处一个柔软蓬松的世界，那里生活着名为Fluffs的生物。在眼下无法回家的情况下，你只能在这个奇幻国度Fluffland开始新生活。

和Fluffs互动，陪伴它们度过生活！你会想办法回家，还是愿意永远留在Fluffland？

无论如何，你都可以探索这个魔法世界，解锁新内容，并找出这片蓬松世界、Fluffland及其居民背后的秘密。

[来源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fluffness/fluffland]Kickstarter[/url]]
